feature: The deck order's memory, and the colour control's box
note:
Two small rulings on three routes. The `/decks` rows open the sort menu, because that is where the capitalised labels are drawn and a closed trigger only shows the one in force.

The colour control is TWO rows per lane, split on `widths`, because it is two controls: above 1000px the rack draws it inline inside a bordered box, and below that `FilterSheet` returns null until `Filters` is pressed. The wide rows are the evidence — the box that was lopsided is that one — and the sheet rows show the same pips with no box at all. Split rather than one row with an optional click: a step that may find nothing cannot fail, so a regressed `Filters` trigger would photograph a closed route and read as coverage.

No `shares` block: the colour control is already one component (`ui/colour-pips.tsx` inside `rack/colour-control.tsx`), which is why one 6px padding fixed both lanes at once. Steps are Playwright verbs, and every one of them is scoped to the page.
